info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Documents-v4-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Documents Retrieval API allows authorized users to access and list all documents associated with mortgage loans. This endpoint provides a comprehensive overview of relevant documentation crucial for evaluating loan applications and processing. It is primarily utilized by financial institutions, mortgage brokers, and loan officers to streamline the document verification process. By leveraging this API, users can efficiently manage and retrieve essential documents, ultimately enhancing workflow efficiency and decision-making capabilities.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all relevant documents associated with loans. It provides a comprehensive overview of the documentation required for processing and managing loans.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of loan documents.
